PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Accomplished Project Manager, Business Analyst, and Test Lead with over 15+ years of extensive experience delivering large-scale transformation, core platform migration, and regulatory programs across the Cards & Payments domain. Expert in bridging business strategy with technical delivery, stakeholder governance, RAID management, vendor coordination, and zero-defect production rollouts.
